decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck aims to control the board with counterspells and removal while quickly applying pressure with efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection tools like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistent draws and keep up the pressure on opponents. By combining disruption with aggressive creatures, this deck aims to maintain tempo and close out games before opponents can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Gemstone Caverns and Wooded Foothills to cast powerful spells and creatures with Cascade, such as Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst. With a mix of countermagic like Mystical Dispute and disruption like Dead / Gone, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient threats like Questing Beast and Murktide Regent. The inclusion of cards like Subtlety and Misty Rainforest provide additional flexibility and consistency in the deck's strategy, aiming to maintain tempo and pressure throughout the game.

The key concept of this deck is to use a combination of powerful human creatures and disruptive spells to establish a fast and aggressive board presence. The deck aims to quickly build a strong army of humans with abilities that benefit from or enhance each other, such as Thalia's Lieutenant and Champion of the Parish. The inclusion of cards like Reflector Mage and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade disrupts the opponent's strategy, while Aether Vial provides additional mana acceleration. The deck also utilizes a combination of lands that allow for efficient mana production and card advantage.

The main concept of the deck is to mill the opponent's deck as quickly and efficiently as possible, using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity to mill cards from the opponent's library. The deck also includes control elements like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch to deal with threats and disruption. The goal is to fill the opponent's graveyard with Archive Trap and activate Visions of Beyond for card draw. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by milling them out before they can win through traditional means.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost spells and aggressive creatures to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. It utilizes efficient removal and counterspells to control the game while maintaining a fast-paced tempo. The deck also benefits from card selection and card advantage to ensure a consistent flow of threats. With a mix of creatures with prowess abilities and versatile spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of direct damage and disruptive plays.

The deck revolves around using Indomitable Creativity to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield, while also utilizing cards like Wrenn and Six and Leyline Binding for control and recursion. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's plays. Preordain and Spell Pierce provide card selection and counter magic, while Lightning Bolt offers removal. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with a mix of fetch lands and shock lands. This deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently through the use of land bounce effects and Amulet of Vigor, enabling the player to play Primeval Titan early and search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva to start dealing massive amounts of damage. The use of Urza's Saga helps to tutor for key pieces of the combo while also generating additional value with its token generation ability. The deck's main goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of powerful threats and land destruction.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. It utilizes a diverse mana base to support a variety of colored spells, taking advantage of the powerful abilities of cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck, allowing for additional mana ramp. The goal is to apply early pressure and maintain board control throughout the game to secure a victory.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic to cast big spells for free, overwhelming the opponent with a continuous stream of threats. By combining Aggro elements with Cascade cards such as Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck aims to quickly deploy powerful creatures and disruption spells while maintaining card advantage through cascading into additional spells. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Lórien Revealed provides additional control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy and secure the win.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt your opponent's strategy while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt your opponent's hand and graveyard, and using cards like Terminate and Fatal Push to remove threats, the deck aims to maintain control of the game while dealing damage quickly. The inclusion of cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Feign Death provide additional disruptive elements and value to help secure victory.

This combo deck focuses on cheating out powerful creatures by using cards like Transmogrify and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The goal is to get either Archon of Cruelty or The One Ring onto the battlefield as quickly as possible to dominate the game. The deck also has disruption in the form of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt. With a mix of control elements and combo potential, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The key focus of this deck is to aggressively control the board while utilizing powerful creatures like Murktide Regent, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce help protect our creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan, while removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide additional ways to clear the board. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to maintain gas in hand and find key cards.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively using a combination of cheap spells, efficient creatures, and disruption to control the game. It aims to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the board with counter spells and removal. The deck is designed to be fast-paced, using a mix of proactive and reactive elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly casting Cascade spells to put pressure on the opponent while controlling the board with counter spells and removal. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with creatures like Questing Beast and Murktide Regent, while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation. The deck utilizes efficient land drops and creature spells, along with a mix of control and aggression to maintain tempo and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cascade triggers to quickly cast powerful spells for free, overwhelming opponents with aggressive plays and board presence. By chaining together cards like Violent Outburst, Ardent Plea, and Shardless Agent, you can generate massive advantage while applying pressure with creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Crashing Footfalls. The inclusion of counter spells like Force of Negation and disruptive cards like Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional protection and disruption to control the game state. Overall, this deck aims to dominate the board and outpace opponents with its efficient and explosive strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of artifact interaction and powerful creatures like Urza, Lord High Artificer. It aims to generate value and grind out opponents with Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek combo while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal. Urza's Saga provides additional utility and card advantage, while Stoneforge Mystic helps find key equipment like Shadowspear and Kaldra Compleat. The deck is versatile and adaptable, capable of both controlling the game and applying pressure when needed.
